نقطوطي (form XII)
# نَقْطَوْطِي (naqṭawṭī) /naq.tˤaw.tˤiː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِقْطَوْطَى (iqṭawṭā)
# نَقْطَوْطِيَ (naqṭawṭiya) /naq.tˤaw.tˤi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِقْطَوْطَى (iqṭawṭā)
